scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Max LTV 25–30% on volatile collateral (liquidation is often near 80%+)
Prefer collateral whose yield covers the interest (strategy #25)
Consider fixed-rate borrowing when a rate spike would force a sale (strategy #22)
Repayment source named before borrowing (income, reserve, maturing PT)
scenes.vo: Wealthy clients rarely sell appreciating assets to raise cash; they borrow against them. DeFi money markets offer the same: deposit collateral, borrow stablecoins, repay when it suits you, with no credit check. The collateral is liquidated if you breach the threshold, and nobody calls first. A credit policy (write yours): First, Max L.T.V. 25 to 30% on volatile collateral (liquidation is often near 80%+). Next, Health factor floor 2.5; act at 2.0. Then, Prefer collateral whose yield covers the interest (strategy #25). Also, Consider fixed-rate borrowing when a rate spike would force a sale (strategy #22). On top of that, Repayment source named before borrowing (income, reserve, maturing P.T.).

scenes.title: Worked example: $200,000 of liquid-staked ETH earning 3.2%…
steps: ETH would have to fall ~75% before liquidation (HF falls in proportion to…
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. $200,000 of liquid-staked ETH earning 3.2% ($6,400 a year). Borrow $40,000 stablecoins at 5% ($2,000 a year). Yield covers interest 3.2 times . L.T.V. 20%. health factor 4.0 at a 0.8 threshold. ETH would have to fall about 75% before liquidation (health factor falls in proportion to price). Defence plan: at health factor 2.0, repay from reserve; at health factor 1.7, sell part of the collateral deliberately rather than let a liquidator do it at a penalty.

scenes.q: Why borrow against assets instead of selling them?
scenes.a: You keep the asset and its upside (and in some jurisdictions avoid a taxable sale), at the cost of interest and liquidation risk.

scenes.q: HF is 4.0. Roughly how far can collateral fall before liquidation?
scenes.a: About 75%, since HF scales with collateral price (HF 1.0 at a quarter of the current price).

scenes.q: What should happen at your action level?
scenes.a: Repay or add collateral per the written plan. Sell deliberately before a liquidator does it at a penalty.
